name: Terror of the High Seas
description: The creature is surrounded by a supernatural aura of dread. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature immersed in water has disadvantage on this saving throw. A frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the creature’s Terror of the High Seas for the next 24 hours.
